option.DisplayText: {{M|Feature: Zone Trade}} (Requires Keybind - Check Control Mappings under 'Mod: M32's QoL')
option.helptext: When enabled, use the key bind to trade with all friendly merchants in the current zone at once.

option.DisplayText: {{M|Feature: Consolidate Liquids}} (Requires Keybind - Check Control Mappings under 'Mod: M32's QoL')
option.helptext: When enabled, use the key bind to consolidate liquids of the same type into larger containers. Only uses the containers the liquids are already using for many reasons. Does not work if you are in the Inventory/Trade UI, use when you are in-game. Neutron flux is never consolidated to avoid dying under the weight of a thousand suns.

When enabled, automatically merges compatible item stacks when opening inventory or trade. Only stacks items with identical properties, modifications, and appearance. Liquid containers can stack if empty; other containers do not stack. Helps reduce unnecessary scrolling when looking at your inventory.
Automatically pick up nearby items when moving.
Continue auto-looting while enemies are nearby.
Don't auto-loot items that belong to others (would be considered stealing).
Only loot items if you won't become over-encumbered.

option.DisplayText: Pickup Player Dropped Items After X Turns
option.helptext: Don't auto-loot items you dropped within this many turns. -1 = never pickup dropped items.
Auto-loot empty non-liquid containers (chests, sacks). Contents are always looted from containers.
